name: WOOVO Phuket Patong – by Swandor
detail: Good located in a side street at patong, only a 10 minutes walk to the beach. Nice view to the ocean from the 8th floor. The rooms were big and clean, modern and new. Would really recommend this hotel.

name: Pearl Hotel Phuket
detail: The Pearl Hotel in Phuket is an enjoyable place to spend a holiday or just relax time in downtown Phuket. The staff are as friendly, positive, and helpful as I have seen in a medium size hotel here. The pool is in a beautiful jungle filled garden with waterfalls- about as relaxing as you can get. While the rooms are a bit old, they are adequate, spacious, with good views overlooking Phuket town. The included breakfast meals are not exciting- but just fine. The value for the cost is good. I will be happy to go to the Pearl again. Wes B.

name: Wyndham Grand Nai Harn Beach Phuket
detail: Overall worth the visit, one of the best hotels I’ve stayed.
area: Nai Harn Beach,Phuket - View on map

name: Royal Phuket City Hotel
detail: Seems it is the best 3-4 star hotel in Phuket Town. It have 19/F and should be the landmark of Phuket Town, so you can find it easily. The breakfast is in 19/F cafe which offer standard breakfast and I really like the city + sea view. The swimming pool + gym is good too. I like the most is that the staff attitude. They will provide good advise and even help me to print my next hotel information (of course free). It does not like other Thailand hotel which the staff is usually lazy.

name: Lub d Phuket Patong
detail: This is one of the best hostels, more like a hotel to me, that I stayed at in Thailand. I reserved the smallest private room and I was extremely happy with it: it was super clean, modern and functional. Everything worked 100%. The bathroom was clean and immaculate. Water temperature and pressure was excellent. The staff was friendly and excellent as well. I highly suggest that you utilize their inhouse travel services (STA Travel). Toni from STA, booked a full day island tour that was affordable and luxurious. That's all I'm going to say. If you can opt for a better package, go with it, you won't regret it. Also worth mentioning, is that there are so many activities within the hostel that can allow you to relax, socialize and network with people. Somedays, you can just stay inside the 'hostel', away from the hustle of Phuket within a nice environment and still enjoy yourself. Location is excellent: next to a lot of restaurants, food stalls, massage parlor and Walking ST.

name: Patong Resort Hotel
detail: This is a great value for a resort hotel in Phuket. The location could not be any better with the beach, shopping and a quick walk to Banglor street for the part action. The down fall is the interaction with walking by the taylor shop to get to the lobby. The guy working the shop almost will pull you into the store time after time after saying your not interested for five days. Hotel needs to fix this. Other than this it is a great place to stay and I would stay here again.

name: The Blue Hotel
detail: Best place to stay if you are training at one of the gyms in Chalong. So peaceful and a gorgeous hotel I looked forward to coming back to every day. Great value for money, I paid €21 a night for a massive deluxe room (low season but not much more expensive in high) and it was way better than expected, extremely clean and generous with toiletries, coffee etc in room. Tv has USB. Nice rooftop pool and small hotel gym. Free coffee and fruit, toaster and microwave area so you could actually make your own food if you wanted. Staff were amazing, so so friendly and helpful I will 100% be back here, nicest stay in Thailand so far. Also booked a taxi and ferry to Koh Phi Phi from reception for 600BHT, so helpful! Thanks for a great stay!

name: Hotel Clover Patong Phuket
detail: SURF provided great value considering the cleanliness and sweeping views of the ocean and city from the poolside. Would recommend to anyone looking for the best hotel in Phuket.

name: Ibis Styles Phuket City
detail: The hotel, apparently less than two years old, makes up for its lack of facilities (like swimming pool, gym, sauna) by its centrally location (especially for those visitors who prefer to stay & explore old Phuket town rather than the beaches), friendly & highly attentive staff, and very clean & well-maintained rooms & compounds! This is a family vacation (my parents and I), and the family suite with one queen-sized bed and a bunk-bed, 2 TVs, a study desk area and a colorful sofa/couch, that we stayed at, fully met our needs. The hotel is a 10-15 mins walking distance to Old Phuket Town. Right outside the hotel is a big Robinson Shopping Center with MacDonalds & KFC, a big wet market / food center, bars, restaurants and massage parlors. The hotel staff from Front Desk to Housekeeping are very friendly and attentive to all our requests! Definitely very value for money!

name: Selina Serenity Rawai Phuket
detail: Unbeatable 5 star resort on Phuket. Booked a 1 bedroom sea view, but upon arrival found out they upgraded us to a 2 bedroom penthouse. 150m2 appartment with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 60m2 rooftop balcony. State of the art equiped with 3 lcd tv's, and 4 airconditioning units. Swimming pool great and restaurant excellent as well. The restaurant is relatively expensive, but that seems to be the trend for hotel-restaurants everywhere in Thailand. 2 minor points of criticism: - Each bed had 4 pillows, but all are of the same type. Rather hard and thick, while feathered pillows should be the standard. - The sea on this side of Phuket is not really made for swimming. Sand is very coarse and water shallow up to 300 meters from the shore. Keep in mind that these minor downsides are close to neglectable. We spend 1 month in Thailand, and stayed exclusively in 5 star accomodations, of which none came close to the Serenity Resort
